verses.english: David said, “My son Solomon is young and tender, and the house to be built for YHWH must be exceedingly great, renowned and glorious throughout all lands. Let me now prepare for it.” David prepared in abundance before his death.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד שְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי נַעַר וָרָךְ וְהַבַּיִת לִבְנוֹת לַיהוָה לְהַגְדִּיל לְמַעְלָה לְשֵׁם וּלְתִפְאֶרֶת לְכָל־הָאֲרָצוֹת אָכִינָה נָּא לוֹ וַיָּכֶן דָּוִיד לָרֹב לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: He called Solomon his son and commanded him to build a house for YHWH, the God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house for the name of YHWH my God.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד לִשְׁלֹמֹה בנו [בְּנִי] אֲנִי הָיָה עִם־לְבָבִי לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: But YHWH's word came upon me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You shall not build a house for My name, because you have shed much blood upon the earth before Me.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עָלַי דְּבַר־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר דָּם לָרֹב שָׁפַכְתָּ וּמִלְחָמוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת עָשִׂיתָ לֹא־תִבְנֶה בַיִת לִשְׁמִי כִּי דָּמִים רַבִּים שָׁפַכְתָּ אַרְצָה לְפָנָי׃

verses.english: Look, a son will be born to you; he will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies around him, for his name will be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־בֵן נוֹלָד לָךְ הוּא יִהְיֶה אִישׁ מְנוּחָה וַהֲנִחוֹתִי לוֹ מִכָּל־אוֹיְבָיו מִסָּבִיב כִּי שְׁלֹמֹה יִהְיֶה שְׁמוֹ וְשָׁלוֹם וָשֶׁקֶט אֶתֵּן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָמָיו׃

verses.english: He will build a house for My name. He will be a son to Me, and I will be a Father to him. I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
verses.hebrew: הוּא־יִבְנֶה בַיִת לִשְׁמִי וְהוּא יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבֵן וַאֲנִי־לוֹ לְאָב וַהֲכִינוֹתִי כִּסֵּא מַלְכוּתוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Now, my son, may YHWH be with you, so that you may succeed and build the house of YHWH your God, as He spoke concerning you.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה בְנִי יְהִי יְהוָה עִמָּךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ וּבָנִיתָ בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר עָלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Only may YHWH give you insight and understanding, and commission you over Israel, so that you may keep the instruction of YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ יִתֶּן־לְּךָ יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל וּבִינָה וִיצַוְּךָ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִשְׁמוֹר אֶת־תּוֹרַת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Then you will succeed, if you take care to do the statutes and judgments that YHWH commanded Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous; do not fear or be dismayed.
verses.hebrew: אָז תַּצְלִיחַ אִם־תִּשְׁמוֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ אַל־תִּירָא וְאַל־תֵּחָת׃

verses.english: Look, in my affliction I have prepared for YHWH's house a hundred thousand talents of gold and a million talents of silver, with bronze and iron beyond weighing because there is so much. I have also prepared timber and stones, and you may add to them.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה בְעָנְיִי הֲכִינוֹתִי לְבֵית־יְהוָה זָהָב כִּכָּרִים מֵאָה־אֶלֶף וְכֶסֶף אֶלֶף אֲלָפִים כִּכָּרִים וְלַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל אֵין מִשְׁקָל כִּי לָרֹב הָיָה וְעֵצִים וַאֲבָנִים הֲכִינוֹתִי וַעֲלֵיהֶם תּוֹסִיף׃

verses.english: You have workmen in abundance: stonecutters, craftsmen in stone and wood, and everyone skilled in every kind of work.
verses.hebrew: וְעִמְּךָ לָרֹב עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה חֹצְבִים וְחָרָשֵׁי אֶבֶן וָעֵץ וְכָל־חָכָם בְּכָל־מְלָאכָה׃

verses.english: As for gold, silver, bronze, and iron, there is no counting. Arise and act, and may YHWH be with you.”
verses.hebrew: לַזָּהָב לַכֶּסֶף וְלַנְּחֹשֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל אֵין מִסְפָּר קוּם וַעֲשֵׂה וִיהִי יְהוָה עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: David commanded all the officials of Israel to help Solomon his son:
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו דָּוִיד לְכָל־שָׂרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעְזֹר לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ׃

verses.english: “Is not YHWH your God with you? Has He not given you rest on every side? For He has given the land's inhabitants into my hand, and the land has been subdued before YHWH and before His people.
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם עִמָּכֶם וְהֵנִיחַ לָכֶם מִסָּבִיב כִּי נָתַן בְּיָדִי אֵת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְלִפְנֵי עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: Now set your heart and your soul to seek YHWH your God. Arise and build the sanctuary of YHWH God, to bring the ark of YHWH's covenant and God's holy vessels into the house being built for YHWH's name.”
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה תְּנוּ לְבַבְכֶם וְנַפְשְׁכֶם לִדְרוֹשׁ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְקוּמוּ וּבְנוּ אֶת־מִקְדַּשׁ יְהוָה הָאֱלֹהִים לְהָבִיא אֶת־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה וּכְלֵי קֹדֶשׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לַבַּיִת הַנִּבְנֶה לְשֵׁם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: David was old and full of days, and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִיד זָקֵן וְשָׂבַע יָמִים וַיַּמְלֵךְ אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He gathered all Israel's officials, the priests, and the Levites.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֶת־כָּל־שָׂרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward. Their number, counting the men head by head, was thirty-eight thousand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּפְרוּ הַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה וַיְהִי מִסְפָּרָם לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם לִגְבָרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמוֹנָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of YHWH's house, and six thousand were officers and judges.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֵלֶּה לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־יְהוָה עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף וְשֹׁטְרִים וְשֹׁפְטִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים׃

verses.english: Four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand praised YHWH with the instruments that I made for praise.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים שֹׁעֲרִים וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים מְהַלְלִים לַיהוָה בַּכֵּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי לְהַלֵּל׃

verses.english: David divided them into divisions according to Levi's sons: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחָלְקֵם דָּוִיד מַחְלְקוֹת לִבְנֵי לֵוִי לְגֵרְשׁוֹן קְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃

verses.english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
verses.hebrew: לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לַעְדָּן וְשִׁמְעִי׃

verses.english: Ladan's sons: Jehiel the head, Zetham, and Joel—three.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי לַעְדָּן הָרֹאשׁ יְחִיאֵל וְזֵתָם וְיוֹאֵל שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: Shimei's sons: Shelomith, Haziel, and Haran—three. These were the ancestral heads of Ladan.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעִי שלמות [שְׁלוֹמִית] וַחֲזִיאֵל וְהָרָן שְׁלֹשָׁה אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְלַעְדָּן׃

verses.english: Shimei's sons: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were Shimei's sons—four.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעִי יַחַת זִינָא וִיעוּשׁ וּבְרִיעָה אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעִי אַרְבָּעָה׃

verses.english: Jahath was the head, and Zizah the second. Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they became one ancestral house for a single muster.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־יַחַת הָרֹאשׁ וְזִיזָה הַשֵּׁנִי וִיעוּשׁ וּבְרִיעָה לֹא־הִרְבּוּ בָנִים וַיִּהְיוּ לְבֵית אָב לִפְקֻדָּה אֶחָת׃

verses.english: Kohath's sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם יִצְהָר חֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל אַרְבָּעָה׃

verses.english: Amram's sons: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart to consecrate him as most holy, he and his sons forever, to burn offerings before YHWH, to minister to Him, and to bless in His name forever.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עַמְרָם אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה וַיִּבָּדֵל אַהֲרֹן לְהַקְדִּישׁוֹ קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים הוּא־וּבָנָיו עַד־עוֹלָם לְהַקְטִיר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְשָׁרְתוֹ וּלְבָרֵךְ בִּשְׁמוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: As for Moses, the man of God, his sons were reckoned under the tribe of Levi.
verses.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּנָיו יִקָּרְאוּ עַל־שֵׁבֶט הַלֵּוִי׃

verses.english: Moses' sons: Gershom and Eliezer.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה גֵּרְשֹׁם וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר׃

verses.english: Gershom's sons: Shebuel the head.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹם שְׁבוּאֵל הָרֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: Eliezer's sons were Rehabiah the head. Eliezer had no other sons, but Rehabiah's sons became exceedingly many.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־אֱלִיעֶזֶר רְחַבְיָה הָרֹאשׁ וְלֹא־הָיָה לֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר בָּנִים אֲחֵרִים וּבְנֵי רְחַבְיָה רָבוּ לְמָעְלָה׃

verses.english: Izhar's sons: Shelomith the head.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יִצְהָר שְׁלֹמִית הָרֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: Hebron's sons: Jeriah the head, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי חֶבְרוֹן יְרִיָּהוּ הָרֹאשׁ אֲמַרְיָה הַשֵּׁנִי יַחֲזִיאֵל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וִיקַמְעָם הָרְבִיעִי׃

verses.english: Uzziel's sons: Micah the head and Isshiah the second.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל מִיכָה הָרֹאשׁ וְיִשִּׁיָּה הַשֵּׁנִי׃

verses.english: Merari's sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli's sons: Eleazar and Kish.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי בְּנֵי מַחְלִי אֶלְעָזָר וְקִישׁ׃

verses.english: Eleazar died and had no sons, only daughters. The sons of Kish, their kinsmen, married them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת אֶלְעָזָר וְלֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וַיִּשָּׂאוּם בְּנֵי־קִישׁ אֲחֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Mushi's sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth—three.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מוּשִׁי מַחְלִי וְעֵדֶר וִירֵמוֹת שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: These were Levi's sons according to their ancestral houses, the ancestral heads according to their musters, by the number of names, head by head, those doing the work for the service of YHWH's house, from twenty years old and upward.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־לֵוִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתֵיהֶם רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לִפְקוּדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית יְהוָה מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה׃

verses.english: For David said, “YHWH, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has settled in Jerusalem forever.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אָמַר דָּוִיד הֵנִיחַ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעַמּוֹ וַיִּשְׁכֹּן בִּירוּשָׁלִַם עַד־לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: The Levites also no longer have to carry the dwelling and all its vessels for its service.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם לַלְוִיִּם אֵין־לָשֵׂאת אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָיו לַעֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

verses.english: For by David's final words the sons of Levi were numbered from twenty years old and upward.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְדִבְרֵי דָוִיד הָאַחֲרֹנִים הֵמָּה מִסְפַּר בְּנֵי־לֵוִי מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וּלְמָעְלָה׃

verses.english: Their station was at the hand of Aaron's sons for the service of YHWH's house, over the courts and chambers, over the purification of every holy thing, and the work of the service of God's house;
verses.hebrew: כִּי מַעֲמָדָם לְיַד־בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית יְהוָה עַל־הַחֲצֵרוֹת וְעַל־הַלְּשָׁכוֹת וְעַל־טָהֳרַת לְכָל־קֹדֶשׁ וּמַעֲשֵׂה עֲבֹדַת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: for the arranged bread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the unleavened wafers, the pan preparation, the soaked preparation, and every measure of capacity and size;
verses.hebrew: וּלְלֶחֶם הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת וּלְסֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה וְלִרְקִיקֵי הַמַּצּוֹת וְלַמַּחֲבַת וְלַמֻּרְבָּכֶת וּלְכָל־מְשׂוּרָה וּמִדָּה׃

verses.english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise YHWH, and likewise in the evening;
verses.hebrew: וְלַעֲמֹד בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר לְהֹדוֹת וּלְהַלֵּל לַיהוָה וְכֵן לָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: and for every offering of burnt offerings to YHWH on sabbaths, new moons, and appointed festivals, by number according to their prescribed rule, continually before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹל הַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לַיהוָה לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת לֶחֳדָשִׁים וְלַמֹּעֲדִים בְּמִסְפָּר כְּמִשְׁפָּט עֲלֵיהֶם תָּמִיד לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: They were to keep the charge of the Tent of Meeting, the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of Aaron's sons their brothers for the service of YHWH's house.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד וְאֵת מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֲחֵיהֶם לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The sons of Aaron had their divisions. Aaron's sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן מַחְלְקוֹתָם בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר׃

verses.english: Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons. Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא לִפְנֵי אֲבִיהֶם וּבָנִים לֹא־הָיוּ לָהֶם וַיְכַהֲנוּ אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר׃

verses.english: David, Zadok from Eleazar's sons, and Ahimelech from Ithamar's sons divided them according to their appointments in their service.
verses.hebrew: וַיֶּחָלְקֵם דָּוִיד וְצָדוֹק מִן־בְּנֵי אֶלְעָזָר וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ מִן־בְּנֵי אִיתָמָר לִפְקֻדָּתָם בַּעֲבֹדָתָם׃

verses.english: Eleazar's sons were found to have more leading men than Ithamar's sons. They divided them: sixteen heads of ancestral houses for Eleazar's sons, and eight according to their ancestral houses for Ithamar's sons.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּצְאוּ בְנֵי־אֶלְעָזָר רַבִּים לְרָאשֵׁי הַגְּבָרִים מִן־בְּנֵי אִיתָמָר וַיַּחְלְקוּם לִבְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר רָאשִׁים לְבֵית־אָבוֹת שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר וְלִבְנֵי אִיתָמָר לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם שְׁמוֹנָה׃

verses.english: They divided them by lots, these alongside those, because there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of God among Eleazar's sons and among Ithamar's sons.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחְלְקוּם בְּגוֹרָלוֹת אֵלֶּה עִם־אֵלֶּה כִּי־הָיוּ שָׂרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ וְשָׂרֵי הָאֱלֹהִים מִבְּנֵי אֶלְעָזָר וּבִבְנֵי אִיתָמָר׃

verses.english: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, the secretary from Levi, recorded them before the king, the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the ancestral heads of the priests and Levites: one ancestral house selected for Eleazar, and one selected, selected for Ithamar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתְּבֵם שְׁמַעְיָה בֶן־נְתַנְאֵל הַסּוֹפֵר מִן־הַלֵּוִי לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים וְצָדוֹק הַכֹּהֵן וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָר וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַלְוִיִּם בֵּית־אָב אֶחָד אָחֻז לְאֶלְעָזָר וְאָחֻז אָחֻז לְאִיתָמָר׃

verses.english: The first lot came out for Jehoiarib, the second for Jedaiah,
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הָרִאשׁוֹן לִיהוֹיָרִיב לִידַעְיָה הַשֵּׁנִי׃

verses.english: the third for Harim, the fourth for Seorim,
verses.hebrew: לְחָרִם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לִשְׂעֹרִים הָרְבִעִי׃

verses.english: the fifth for Malchijah, the sixth for Mijamin,
verses.hebrew: לְמַלְכִּיָּה הַחֲמִישִׁי לְמִיָּמִן הַשִּׁשִּׁי׃

verses.english: the seventh for Hakkoz, the eighth for Abijah,
verses.hebrew: לְהַקּוֹץ הַשְּׁבִעִי לַאֲבִיָּה הַשְּׁמִינִי׃

verses.english: the ninth for Jeshua, the tenth for Shecaniah,
verses.hebrew: לְיֵשׁוּעַ הַתְּשִׁעִי לִשְׁכַנְיָהוּ הָעֲשִׂרִי׃

verses.english: the eleventh for Eliashib, the twelfth for Jakim,
verses.hebrew: לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר לְיָקִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: the thirteenth for Huppah, the fourteenth for Jeshebeab,
verses.hebrew: לְחֻפָּה שְׁלֹשָׁה עָשָׂר לְיֶשֶׁבְאָב אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: the fifteenth for Bilgah, the sixteenth for Immer,
verses.hebrew: לְבִלְגָּה חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר לְאִמֵּר שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: the seventeenth for Hezir, the eighteenth for Happizzez,
verses.hebrew: לְחֵזִיר שִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר לְהַפִּצֵּץ שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: the nineteenth for Pethahiah, the twentieth for Jehezkel,
verses.hebrew: לִפְתַחְיָה תִּשְׁעָה עָשָׂר לִיחֶזְקֵאל הָעֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: the twenty-first for Jachin, the twenty-second for Gamul,
verses.hebrew: לְיָכִין אֶחָד וְעֶשְׂרִים לְגָמוּל שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: the twenty-third for Delaiah, the twenty-fourth for Maaziah.
verses.hebrew: לִדְלָיָהוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְמַעַזְיָהוּ אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: These were their appointments in their service, to enter YHWH's house according to the rule given through Aaron their father, as YHWH, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְקֻדָּתָם לַעֲבֹדָתָם לָבוֹא לְבֵית־יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם בְּיַד אַהֲרֹן אֲבִיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: As for the remaining sons of Levi: of Amram's sons, Shubael; of Shubael's sons, Jehdeiah.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי לֵוִי הַנּוֹתָרִים לִבְנֵי עַמְרָם שׁוּבָאֵל לִבְנֵי שׁוּבָאֵל יֶחְדְּיָהוּ׃

verses.english: As for Rehabiah: of Rehabiah's sons, Isshiah the head.
verses.hebrew: לִרְחַבְיָהוּ לִבְנֵי רְחַבְיָהוּ הָרֹאשׁ יִשִּׁיָּה׃

verses.english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of Shelomoth's sons, Jahath.
verses.hebrew: לַיִּצְהָרִי שְׁלֹמוֹת לִבְנֵי שְׁלֹמוֹת יָחַת׃

verses.english: And the sons: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנָי יְרִיָּהוּ אֲמַרְיָהוּ הַשֵּׁנִי יַחֲזִיאֵל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יְקַמְעָם הָרְבִיעִי׃

verses.english: Uzziel's sons: Micah; of Micah's sons, Shamir.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עֻזִּיאֵל מִיכָה לִבְנֵי מִיכָה שמור [שָׁמִיר׃]

verses.english: Micah's brother: Isshiah; of Isshiah's sons, Zechariah.
verses.hebrew: אֲחִי מִיכָה יִשִּׁיָּה לִבְנֵי יִשִּׁיָּה זְכַרְיָהוּ׃

verses.english: Merari's sons: Mahli and Mushi; Jaaziah's sons: Beno.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי בְּנֵי יַעֲזִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ׃

verses.english: Merari's sons through Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְיַעֲזִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ וְשֹׁהַם וְזַכּוּר וְעִבְרִי׃

verses.english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.hebrew: לְמַחְלִי אֶלְעָזָר וְלֹא־הָיָה לוֹ בָּנִים׃

verses.english: As for Kish: Kish's sons, Jerahmeel.
verses.hebrew: לְקִישׁ בְּנֵי־קִישׁ יְרַחְמְאֵל׃

verses.english: Mushi's sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their ancestral houses.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מוּשִׁי מַחְלִי וְעֵדֶר וִירִימוֹת אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי הַלְוִיִּם לְבֵית אֲבֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They too cast lots alongside their brothers, Aaron's sons, before King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the ancestral heads of the priests and Levites: the chief ancestral head alongside his younger brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּפִּילוּ גַם־הֵם גּוֹרָלוֹת לְעֻמַּת אֲחֵיהֶם בְּנֵי־אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי דָוִיד הַמֶּלֶךְ וְצָדוֹק וַאֲחִימֶלֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לַכֹּהֲנִים וְלַלְוִיִּם אָבוֹת הָרֹאשׁ לְעֻמַּת אָחִיו הַקָּטָן׃

verses.english: David and the army officials set apart for service the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, who prophesied with lyres, harps, and cymbals. This was their number, the men employed in their service:
verses.hebrew: וַיַּבְדֵּל דָּוִיד וְשָׂרֵי הַצָּבָא לַעֲבֹדָה לִבְנֵי אָסָף וְהֵימָן וִידוּתוּן הנביאים [הַנִּבְּאִים] בְּכִנֹּרוֹת בִּנְבָלִים וּבִמְצִלְתָּיִם וַיְהִי מִסְפָּרָם אַנְשֵׁי מְלָאכָה לַעֲבֹדָתָם׃

verses.english: Of Asaph's sons: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, Asaph's sons under Asaph's hand, who prophesied under the king's hand.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי אָסָף זַכּוּר וְיוֹסֵף וּנְתַנְיָה וַאֲשַׂרְאֵלָה בְּנֵי אָסָף עַל יַד־אָסָף הַנִּבָּא עַל־יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: Of Jeduthun: Jeduthun's sons, Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah—six—under the hand of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre in thanking and praising YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לִידוּתוּן בְּנֵי יְדוּתוּן גְּדַלְיָהוּ וּצְרִי וִישַׁעְיָהוּ חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ וּמַתִּתְיָהוּ שִׁשָּׁה עַל יְדֵי אֲבִיהֶם יְדוּתוּן בַּכִּנּוֹר הַנִּבָּא עַל־הֹדוֹת וְהַלֵּל לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Of Heman: Heman's sons, Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
verses.hebrew: לְהֵימָן בְּנֵי הֵימָן בֻּקִּיָּהוּ מַתַּנְיָהוּ עֻזִּיאֵל שְׁבוּאֵל וִירִימוֹת חֲנַנְיָה חֲנָנִי אֱלִיאָתָה גִדַּלְתִּי וְרֹמַמְתִּי עֶזֶר יָשְׁבְּקָשָׁה מַלּוֹתִי הוֹתִיר מַחֲזִיאוֹת׃

verses.english: All these were sons of Heman, the king's seer in God's words, to lift up a horn. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה בָנִים לְהֵימָן חֹזֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּדִבְרֵי הָאֱלֹהִים לְהָרִים קָרֶן וַיִּתֵּן הָאֱלֹהִים לְהֵימָן בָּנִים אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר וּבָנוֹת שָׁלוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: All these were under their father's hand for song in YHWH's house, with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of God's house. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the king's hand.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה עַל־יְדֵי אֲבִיהֶם בַּשִּׁיר בֵּית יְהוָה בִּמְצִלְתַּיִם נְבָלִים וְכִנֹּרוֹת לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים עַל יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אָסָף וִידוּתוּן וְהֵימָן׃

verses.english: Their number with their brothers, trained in song to YHWH, all skilled, was two hundred eighty-eight.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפָּרָם עִם־אֲחֵיהֶם מְלֻמְּדֵי־שִׁיר לַיהוָה כָּל־הַמֵּבִין מָאתַיִם שְׁמוֹנִים וּשְׁמוֹנָה׃

verses.english: They cast lots for the duties, small alongside great, skilled person with student.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּפִּילוּ גּוֹרָלוֹת מִשְׁמֶרֶת לְעֻמַּת כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדוֹל מֵבִין עִם־תַּלְמִיד׃

verses.english: The first lot came out for Asaph, for Joseph; the second for Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons—twelve.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַגּוֹרָל הָרִאשׁוֹן לְאָסָף לְיוֹסֵף גְּדַלְיָהוּ הַשֵּׁנִי הוּא־וְאֶחָיו וּבָנָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The third: Zaccur, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁלִשִׁי זַכּוּר בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The fourth: Izri, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הָרְבִיעִי לַיִּצְרִי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The fifth: Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הַחֲמִישִׁי נְתַנְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The sixth: Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הַשִּׁשִּׁי בֻקִּיָּהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The seventh: Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁבִעִי יְשַׂרְאֵלָה בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The eighth: Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁמִינִי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The ninth: Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הַתְּשִׁיעִי מַתַּנְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The tenth: Shimei, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הָעֲשִׂירִי שִׁמְעִי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The eleventh: Azarel, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂר עֲזַרְאֵל בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The twelfth: Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁנֵים עָשָׂר לַחֲשַׁבְיָה בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The thirteenth: Shubael, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁלֹשָׁה עָשָׂר שׁוּבָאֵל בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The fourteenth: Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לְאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר מַתִּתְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The fifteenth: Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר לִירֵמוֹת בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The sixteenth: Hananiah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לְשִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר לַחֲנַנְיָהוּ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The seventeenth: Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לְשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר לְיָשְׁבְּקָשָׁה בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The eighteenth: Hanani, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר לַחֲנָנִי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The nineteenth: Mallothi, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לְתִשְׁעָה עָשָׂר לְמַלּוֹתִי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The twentieth: Eliathah, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לְעֶשְׂרִים לֶאֱלִיָּתָה בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The twenty-first: Hothir, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לְאֶחָד וְעֶשְׂרִים לְהוֹתִיר בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The twenty-second: Giddalti, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים לְגִדַּלְתִּי בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The twenty-third: Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְמַחֲזִיאוֹת בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The twenty-fourth: Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brothers—twelve.
verses.hebrew: לְאַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים לְרוֹמַמְתִּי עָזֶר בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: For the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah son of Kore, of Asaph's sons.
verses.hebrew: לְמַחְלְקוֹת לְשֹׁעֲרִים לַקָּרְחִים מְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ בֶן־קֹרֵא מִן־בְּנֵי אָסָף׃

verses.english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.hebrew: וְלִמְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ בָּנִים זְכַרְיָהוּ הַבְּכוֹר יְדִיעֲאֵל הַשֵּׁנִי זְבַדְיָהוּ הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יַתְנִיאֵל הָרְבִיעִי׃

verses.english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
verses.hebrew: עֵילָם הַחֲמִישִׁי יְהוֹחָנָן הַשִּׁשִּׁי אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי הַשְּׁבִיעִי׃

verses.english: Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
verses.hebrew: וּלְעֹבֵד אֱדֹם בָּנִים שְׁמַעְיָה הַבְּכוֹר יְהוֹזָבָד הַשֵּׁנִי יוֹאָח הַשְּׁלִשִׁי וְשָׂכָר הָרְבִיעִי וּנְתַנְאֵל הַחֲמִישִׁי׃

verses.english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth, for God had blessed him.
verses.hebrew: עַמִּיאֵל הַשִּׁשִּׁי יִשָׂשכָר הַשְּׁבִיעִי פְּעֻלְּתַי הַשְּׁמִינִי כִּי בֵרֲכוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Sons were born to Shemaiah his son, rulers in their ancestral house, for they were mighty men of valor.
verses.hebrew: וְלִשְׁמַעְיָה בְנוֹ נוֹלַד בָּנִים הַמִּמְשָׁלִים לְבֵית אֲבִיהֶם כִּי־גִבּוֹרֵי חַיִל הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: Shemaiah's sons: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers, able men, were Elihu and Semachiah.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שְׁמַעְיָה עָתְנִי וּרְפָאֵל וְעוֹבֵד אֶלְזָבָד אֶחָיו בְּנֵי־חָיִל אֱלִיהוּ וּסְמַכְיָהוּ׃

verses.english: All these were of Obed-edom's sons, they and their sons and their brothers, able men with strength for service: sixty-two belonging to Obed-edom.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה מִבְּנֵי עֹבֵד אֱדֹם הֵמָּה וּבְנֵיהֶם וַאֲחֵיהֶם אִישׁ־חַיִל בַּכֹּחַ לַעֲבֹדָה שִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁנַיִם לְעֹבֵד אֱדֹם׃

verses.english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, able men—eighteen.
verses.hebrew: וְלִמְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ בָּנִים וְאַחִים בְּנֵי־חָיִל שְׁמוֹנָה עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: Hosah, of Merari's sons, had sons: Shimri the head, for although he was not the firstborn, his father appointed him head;
verses.hebrew: וּלְחֹסָה מִן־בְּנֵי־מְרָרִי בָּנִים שִׁמְרִי הָרֹאשׁ כִּי לֹא־הָיָה בְכוֹר וַיְשִׂימֵהוּ אָבִיהוּ לְרֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth. All Hosah's sons and brothers were thirteen.
verses.hebrew: חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַשֵּׁנִי טְבַלְיָהוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁי זְכַרְיָהוּ הָרְבִעִי כָּל־בָּנִים וְאַחִים לְחֹסָה שְׁלֹשָׁה עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: These divisions of gatekeepers, belonging to the leading men, had duties alongside their brothers to minister in YHWH's house.
verses.hebrew: לְאֵלֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת הַשֹּׁעֲרִים לְרָאשֵׁי הַגְּבָרִים מִשְׁמָרוֹת לְעֻמַּת אֲחֵיהֶם לְשָׁרֵת בְּבֵית יְהוָה׃

verses.english: They cast lots, small and great alike, according to their ancestral houses, for each gate.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּפִּילוּ גוֹרָלוֹת כַּקָּטֹן כַּגָּדוֹל לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם לְשַׁעַר וָשָׁעַר׃

verses.english: The eastward lot fell to Shelemiah. For his son Zechariah, an insightful counselor, they cast lots, and his lot came out northward.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל הַגּוֹרָל מִזְרָחָה לְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ וּזְכַרְיָהוּ בְנוֹ יוֹעֵץ בְּשֶׂכֶל הִפִּילוּ גּוֹרָלוֹת וַיֵּצֵא גוֹרָלוֹ צָפוֹנָה׃

verses.english: To Obed-edom fell the south, and to his sons the storehouse.
verses.hebrew: לְעֹבֵד אֱדֹם נֶגְבָּה וּלְבָנָיו בֵּית הָאֲסֻפִּים׃

verses.english: To Shuppim and Hosah fell the west, with the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway, guard alongside guard.
verses.hebrew: לְשֻׁפִּים וּלְחֹסָה לַמַּעֲרָב עִם שַׁעַר שַׁלֶּכֶת בַּמְסִלָּה הָעוֹלָה מִשְׁמָר לְעֻמַּת מִשְׁמָר׃

verses.english: To the east were six Levites; to the north, four each day; to the south, four each day; and for the storehouses, two and two.
verses.hebrew: לַמִּזְרָח הַלְוִיִּם שִׁשָּׁה לַצָּפוֹנָה לַיּוֹם אַרְבָּעָה לַנֶּגְבָּה לַיּוֹם אַרְבָּעָה וְלָאֲסֻפִּים שְׁנַיִם שְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: For the Parbar on the west: four at the highway and two at the Parbar.
verses.hebrew: לַפַּרְבָּר לַמַּעֲרָב אַרְבָּעָה לַמְסִלָּה שְׁנַיִם לַפַּרְבָּר׃

verses.english: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers belonging to the Korahites and Merari's sons.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת הַשֹּׁעֲרִים לִבְנֵי הַקָּרְחִי וְלִבְנֵי מְרָרִי׃

verses.english: As for the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasuries of God's house and the treasuries of the consecrated things.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם אֲחִיָּה עַל־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וּלְאֹצְרוֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

verses.english: Ladan's sons, the sons of the Gershonite belonging to Ladan, the ancestral heads belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי לַעְדָּן בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְלַעְדָּן רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְלַעְדָּן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי יְחִיאֵלִי׃

verses.english: Jehieli's sons: Zetham and Joel his brother, over the treasuries of YHWH's house.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יְחִיאֵלִי זֵתָם וְיוֹאֵל אָחִיו עַל־אֹצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
verses.hebrew: לַעַמְרָמִי לַיִּצְהָרִי לַחֶבְרוֹנִי לָעָזִּיאֵלִי׃

verses.english: Shebuel son of Gershom son of Moses was leader over the treasuries.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁבֻאֵל בֶּן־גֵּרְשׁוֹם בֶּן־מֹשֶׁה נָגִיד עַל־הָאֹצָרוֹת׃

verses.english: His brothers through Eliezer were Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶחָיו לֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר רְחַבְיָהוּ בְנוֹ וִישַׁעְיָהוּ בְנוֹ וְיֹרָם בְּנוֹ וְזִכְרִי בְנוֹ ושלמות [וּשְׁלֹמִית] בְּנוֹ׃

verses.english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the consecrated things that King David, the ancestral heads, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the army commanders had consecrated.
verses.hebrew: הוּא שְׁלֹמוֹת וְאֶחָיו עַל כָּל־אֹצְרוֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּישׁ דָּוִיד הַמֶּלֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְשָׂרֵי־הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וְשָׂרֵי הַצָּבָא׃

verses.english: From the wars and from the spoil they consecrated gifts to strengthen YHWH's house.
verses.hebrew: מִן־הַמִּלְחָמוֹת וּמִן־הַשָּׁלָל הִקְדִּישׁוּ לְחַזֵּק לְבֵית יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Also all that Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah had consecrated—everything consecrated was under the hand of Shelomith and his brothers.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל הַהִקְדִּישׁ שְׁמוּאֵל הָרֹאֶה וְשָׁאוּל בֶּן־קִישׁ וְאַבְנֵר בֶּן־נֵר וְיוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה כֹּל הַמַּקְדִּישׁ עַל יַד־שְׁלֹמִית וְאֶחָיו׃

verses.english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were assigned outside work over Israel as officers and judges.
verses.hebrew: לַיִּצְהָרִי כְּנַנְיָהוּ וּבָנָיו לַמְּלָאכָה הַחִיצוֹנָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְשֹׁטְרִים וּלְשֹׁפְטִים׃

verses.english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, able men, a thousand seven hundred, had oversight of Israel west of the Jordan for all YHWH's work and the king's service.
verses.hebrew: לַחֶבְרוֹנִי חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ וְאֶחָיו בְּנֵי־חַיִל אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת עַל פְּקֻדַּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן מַעְרָבָה לְכֹל מְלֶאכֶת יְהוָה וְלַעֲבֹדַת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: Of the Hebronites, Jeriah was the head of the Hebronites according to their genealogies and ancestral houses. In the fortieth year of David's reign they were sought out, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer in Gilead.
verses.hebrew: לַחֶבְרוֹנִי יְרִיָּה הָרֹאשׁ לַחֶבְרוֹנִי לְתֹלְדֹתָיו לְאָבוֹת בִּשְׁנַת הָאַרְבָּעִים לְמַלְכוּת דָּוִיד נִדְרָשׁוּ וַיִּמָּצֵא בָהֶם גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל בְּיַעְזֵיר גִּלְעָד׃

verses.english: His brothers, able men, were two thousand seven hundred ancestral heads. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh for every matter of God and matter of the king.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶחָיו בְּנֵי־חַיִל אַלְפַּיִם וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת וַיַּפְקִידֵם דָּוִיד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הָראוּבֵנִי וְהַגָּדִי וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט הַמְנַשִּׁי לְכָל־דְּבַר הָאֱלֹהִים וּדְבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel according to their number, the ancestral heads, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and their officers served the king in every matter of the divisions that came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year. Each division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִסְפָּרָם רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת וְשָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וְשֹׁטְרֵיהֶם הַמְשָׁרְתִים אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ לְכֹל דְּבַר הַמַּחְלְקוֹת הַבָּאָה וְהַיֹּצֵאת חֹדֶשׁ בְּחֹדֶשׁ לְכֹל חָדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת הָאַחַת עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: Over the first division, for the first month, was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: עַל הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן יָשָׁבְעָם בֶּן־זַבְדִּיאֵל וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: He was of Perez's sons, the head of all the army commanders for the first month.
verses.hebrew: מִן־בְּנֵי־פֶרֶץ הָרֹאשׁ לְכָל־שָׂרֵי הַצְּבָאוֹת לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

verses.english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and his division, with Mikloth the leader. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל מַחֲלֹקֶת הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי דּוֹדַי הָאֲחוֹחִי וּמַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ וּמִקְלוֹת הַנָּגִיד וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The third army commander, for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest, as head. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: שַׂר הַצָּבָא הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בְּנָיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן רֹאשׁ וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: This was Benaiah, a mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. His son Ammizabad was over his division.
verses.hebrew: הוּא בְנָיָהוּ גִּבּוֹר הַשְּׁלֹשִׁים וְעַל־הַשְּׁלֹשִׁים וּמַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עַמִּיזָבָד בְּנוֹ׃

verses.english: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel, Joab's brother, and his son Zebadiah after him. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הָרְבִיעִי לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרְבִיעִי עֲשָׂה־אֵל אֲחִי יוֹאָב וּזְבַדְיָה בְנוֹ אַחֲרָיו וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הַחַמִישִׁי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי הַשַּׂר שַׁמְהוּת הַיִּזְרָח וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הַשִּׁשִּׁי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשִּׁשִּׁי עִירָא בֶן־עִקֵּשׁ הַתְּקוֹעִי וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, of Ephraim's sons. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁבִיעִי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי חֶלֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִי מִן־בְּנֵי אֶפְרָיִם וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁמִינִי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִי סִבְּכַי הַחֻשָׁתִי לַזַּרְחִי וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, of Benjamin. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הַתְּשִׁיעִי לַחֹדֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִי אֲבִיעֶזֶר הָעַנְּתֹתִי לבנימיני [לַבֵּן ] [יְמִינִי] וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הָעֲשִׂירִי לַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי מַהְרַי הַנְּטוֹפָתִי לַזַּרְחִי וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of Ephraim's sons. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂר לְעַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂר הַחֹדֶשׁ בְּנָיָה הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי מִן־בְּנֵי אֶפְרָיִם וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. His division had twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׁנֵים עָשָׂר לִשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הַחֹדֶשׁ חֶלְדַּי הַנְּטוֹפָתִי לְעָתְנִיאֵל וְעַל מַחֲלֻקְתּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אָלֶף׃

verses.english: Over Israel's tribes: for the Reubenites, Eliezer son of Zichri was leader; for the Simeonites, Shephatiah son of Maacah;
verses.hebrew: וְעַל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָראוּבֵנִי נָגִיד אֱלִיעֶזֶר בֶּן־זִכְרִי לַשִּׁמְעוֹנִי שְׁפַטְיָהוּ בֶּן־מַעֲכָה׃

verses.english: for Levi, Hashabiah son of Kemuel; for Aaron, Zadok;
verses.hebrew: לְלֵוִי חֲשַׁבְיָה בֶן־קְמוּאֵל לְאַהֲרֹן צָדוֹק׃

verses.english: for Judah, Elihu, one of David's brothers; for Issachar, Omri son of Michael;
verses.hebrew: לִיהוּדָה אֱלִיהוּ מֵאֲחֵי דָוִיד לְיִשָׂשכָר עָמְרִי בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל׃

verses.english: for Zebulun, Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth son of Azriel;
verses.hebrew: לִזְבוּלֻן יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ בֶּן־עֹבַדְיָהוּ לְנַפְתָּלִי יְרִימוֹת בֶּן־עַזְרִיאֵל׃

verses.english: for Ephraim's sons, Hoshea son of Azaziah; for half the tribe of Manasseh, Joel son of Pedaiah;
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־עֲזַזְיָהוּ לַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה יוֹאֵל בֶּן־פְּדָיָהוּ׃

verses.english: for the half of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo son of Zechariah; for Benjamin, Jaasiel son of Abner;
verses.hebrew: לַחֲצִי הַמְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה יִדּוֹ בֶּן־זְכַרְיָהוּ לְבִנְיָמִן יַעֲשִׂיאֵל בֶּן־אַבְנֵר׃

verses.english: for Dan, Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the officials of Israel's tribes.
verses.hebrew: לְדָן עֲזַרְאֵל בֶּן־יְרֹחָם אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: David did not take their number from twenty years old and downward, because YHWH had said He would multiply Israel like the stars of heaven.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נָשָׂא דָוִיד מִסְפָּרָם לְמִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וּלְמָטָּה כִּי אָמַר יְהוָה לְהַרְבּוֹת אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count but did not finish. Because of this wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not entered in the account of King David's chronicles.
verses.hebrew: יוֹאָב בֶּן־צְרוּיָה הֵחֵל לִמְנוֹת וְלֹא כִלָּה וַיְהִי בָזֹאת קֶצֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא עָלָה הַמִּסְפָּר בְּמִסְפַּר דִּבְרֵי־הַיָּמִים לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִיד׃

verses.english: Over the king's treasuries was Azmaveth son of Adiel. Over the storehouses in the countryside, cities, villages, and towers was Jonathan son of Uzziah.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל אֹצְרוֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ עַזְמָוֶת בֶּן־עֲדִיאֵל וְעַל הָאֹצָרוֹת בַּשָּׂדֶה בֶּעָרִים וּבַכְּפָרִים וּבַמִּגְדָּלוֹת יְהוֹנָתָן בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּהוּ׃

verses.english: Over those doing field work for cultivating the ground was Ezri son of Chelub.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל עֹשֵׂי מְלֶאכֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לַעֲבֹדַת הָאֲדָמָה עֶזְרִי בֶּן־כְּלוּב׃

verses.english: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over what was in the vineyards for the wine stores was Zabdi the Shiphmite.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַכְּרָמִים שִׁמְעִי הָרָמָתִי וְעַל שֶׁבַּכְּרָמִים לְאֹצְרוֹת הַיַּיִן זַבְדִּי הַשִּׁפְמִי׃

verses.english: Over the olive trees and sycamore-fig trees in the lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite. Over the oil stores was Joash.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַזֵּיתִים וְהַשִּׁקְמִים אֲשֶׁר בַּשְּׁפֵלָה בַּעַל חָנָן הַגְּדֵרִי וְעַל־אֹצְרוֹת הַשֶּׁמֶן יוֹעָשׁ׃

verses.english: Over the cattle grazing in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the cattle in the valleys was Shaphat son of Adlai.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַבָּקָר הָרֹעִים בַּשָּׁרוֹן שטרי [שִׁרְטַי] הַשָּׁרוֹנִי וְעַל־הַבָּקָר בָּעֲמָקִים שָׁפָט בֶּן־עַדְלָי׃

verses.english: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the female donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַגְּמַלִּים אוֹבִיל הַיִּשְׁמְעֵלִי וְעַל־הָאֲתֹנוֹת יֶחְדְּיָהוּ הַמֵּרֹנֹתִי׃

verses.english: Over the flock was Jaziz the Hagrite. All these were officials over King David's property.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־הַצֹּאן יָזִיז הַהַגְרִי כָּל־אֵלֶּה שָׂרֵי הָרְכוּשׁ אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִיד׃

verses.english: Jonathan, David's uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons.
verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹנָתָן דּוֹד־דָּוִיד יוֹעֵץ אִישׁ־מֵבִין וְסוֹפֵר הוּא וִיחִיאֵל בֶּן־חַכְמוֹנִי עִם־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: Ahithophel was counselor to the king, and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲחִיתֹפֶל יוֹעֵץ לַמֶּלֶךְ וְחוּשַׁי הָאַרְכִּי רֵעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: After Ahithophel were Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar. The king's army commander was Joab.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי אֲחִיתֹפֶל יְהוֹיָדָע בֶּן־בְּנָיָהוּ וְאֶבְיָתָר וְשַׂר־צָבָא לַמֶּלֶךְ יוֹאָב׃

verses.english: David assembled in Jerusalem all Israel's officials: the tribal officials, the officials of the divisions serving the king, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the officials over all the property and livestock of the king and his sons, with the court officers, the mighty men, and every man of valor.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְהֵל דָּוִיד אֶת־כָּל־שָׂרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׂרֵי הַשְּׁבָטִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמַּחְלְקוֹת הַמְשָׁרְתִים אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְשָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת וְשָׂרֵי כָל־רְכוּשׁ־וּמִקְנֶה לַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְבָנָיו עִם־הַסָּרִיסִים וְהַגִּבּוֹרִים וּלְכָל־גִּבּוֹר חָיִל אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: King David stood upon his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people. I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of YHWH's covenant and for the footstool of our God, and I prepared to build.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם דָּוִיד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־רַגְלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמָעוּנִי אַחַי וְעַמִּי אֲנִי עִם־לְבָבִי לִבְנוֹת בֵּית מְנוּחָה לַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה וְלַהֲדֹם רַגְלֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַהֲכִינוֹתִי לִבְנוֹת׃

verses.english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for My name, because you are a man of wars and have shed blood.’
verses.hebrew: וְהָאֱלֹהִים אָמַר לִי לֹא־תִבְנֶה בַיִת לִשְׁמִי כִּי אִישׁ מִלְחָמוֹת אַתָּה וְדָמִים שָׁפָכְתָּ׃

verses.english: YHWH, the God of Israel, chose me from all my father's house to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as leader, and in Judah's house my father's house, and among my father's sons He was pleased with me to make me king over all Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּי מִכֹּל בֵּית־אָבִי לִהְיוֹת לְמֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעוֹלָם כִּי בִיהוּדָה בָּחַר לְנָגִיד וּבְבֵית יְהוּדָה בֵּית אָבִי וּבִבְנֵי אָבִי בִּי רָצָה לְהַמְלִיךְ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: From all my sons—for YHWH has given me many sons—He chose Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of YHWH's kingdom over Israel.
verses.hebrew: וּמִכָּל־בָּנַי כִּי רַבִּים בָּנִים נָתַן לִי יְהוָה וַיִּבְחַר בִּשְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי לָשֶׁבֶת עַל־כִּסֵּא מַלְכוּת יְהוָה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He said to me, ‘Solomon your son will build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him as a son to Me, and I will be a Father to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי שְׁלֹמֹה בִנְךָ הוּא־יִבְנֶה בֵיתִי וַחֲצֵרוֹתָי כִּי־בָחַרְתִּי בוֹ לִי לְבֵן וַאֲנִי אֶהְיֶה־לּוֹ לְאָב׃

verses.english: I will establish his kingdom forever, if he remains strong to do My commandments and My judgments, as on this day.’
verses.hebrew: וַהֲכִינוֹתִי אֶת־מַלְכוּתוֹ עַד־לְעוֹלָם אִם־יֶחֱזַק לַעֲשׂוֹת מִצְוֺתַי וּמִשְׁפָּטַי כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Now, before the eyes of all Israel, YHWH's assembly, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek all the commandments of YHWH your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your sons after you forever.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְעֵינֵי כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל קְהַל־יְהוָה וּבְאָזְנֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ שִׁמְרוּ וְדִרְשׁוּ כָּל־מִצְוֺת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לְמַעַן תִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַטּוֹבָה וְהִנְחַלְתֶּם לִבְנֵיכֶם אַחֲרֵיכֶם עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him with a whole heart and a willing soul, for YHWH searches every heart and understands every formation of thoughts. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה שְׁלֹמֹה־בְנִי דַּע אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי אָבִיךָ וְעָבְדֵהוּ בְּלֵב שָׁלֵם וּבְנֶפֶשׁ חֲפֵצָה כִּי כָל־לְבָבוֹת דּוֹרֵשׁ יְהוָה וְכָל־יֵצֶר מַחֲשָׁבוֹת מֵבִין אִם־תִּדְרְשֶׁנּוּ יִמָּצֵא לָךְ וְאִם־תַּעַזְבֶנּוּ יַזְנִיחֲךָ לָעַד׃

verses.english: See now that YHWH has chosen you to build a house as a sanctuary. Be strong and act.”
verses.hebrew: רְאֵה עַתָּה כִּי־יְהוָה בָּחַר בְּךָ לִבְנוֹת־בַּיִת לַמִּקְדָּשׁ חֲזַק וַעֲשֵׂה׃

verses.english: David gave Solomon his son the plan of the vestibule, its houses, its treasuries, its upper rooms, its inner chambers, and the room of the atonement cover;
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן דָּוִיד לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ אֶת־תַּבְנִית הָאוּלָם וְאֶת־בָּתָּיו וְגַנְזַכָּיו וַעֲלִיֹּתָיו וַחֲדָרָיו הַפְּנִימִים וּבֵית הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

verses.english: and the plan of all that was with him in spirit: the courts of YHWH's house, all the surrounding chambers, the treasuries of God's house, and the treasuries of the consecrated things;
verses.hebrew: וְתַבְנִית כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בָרוּחַ עִמּוֹ לְחַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה וּלְכָל־הַלְּשָׁכוֹת סָבִיב לְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וּלְאֹצְרוֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

verses.english: and for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of the service of YHWH's house, and for all the vessels of the service of YHWH's house;
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַחְלְקוֹת הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וּלְכָל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית־יְהוָה וּלְכָל־כְּלֵי עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: for the gold by weight, gold for all the vessels of each kind of service, and for all the silver vessels by weight, for all the vessels of each kind of service;
verses.hebrew: לַזָּהָב בַּמִּשְׁקָל לַזָּהָב לְכָל־כְּלֵי עֲבוֹדָה וַעֲבוֹדָה לְכֹל כְּלֵי הַכֶּסֶף בְּמִשְׁקָל לְכָל־כְּלֵי עֲבוֹדָה וַעֲבוֹדָה׃

verses.english: and the weight for the golden lampstands and their golden lamps, by the weight of each lampstand and its lamps; and for the silver lampstands, by weight for each lampstand and its lamps, according to the service of each lampstand;
verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁקָל לִמְנֹרוֹת הַזָּהָב וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶם זָהָב בְּמִשְׁקַל־מְנוֹרָה וּמְנוֹרָה וְנֵרֹתֶיהָ וְלִמְנֹרוֹת הַכֶּסֶף בְּמִשְׁקָל לִמְנוֹרָה וְנֵרֹתֶיהָ כַּעֲבוֹדַת מְנוֹרָה וּמְנוֹרָה׃

verses.english: and the gold by weight for the tables of arrangement, for each table, and silver for the silver tables;
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב מִשְׁקָל לְשֻׁלְחֲנוֹת הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְשֻׁלְחַן וְשֻׁלְחָן וְכֶסֶף לְשֻׁלְחֲנוֹת הַכָּסֶף׃

verses.english: and the forks, sprinkling basins, and pitchers of pure gold; and for the golden bowls, the weight of each bowl, and for the silver bowls, the weight of each bowl;
verses.hebrew: וְהַמִּזְלָגוֹת וְהַמִּזְרָקוֹת וְהַקְּשָׂוֺת זָהָב טָהוֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵי הַזָּהָב בְּמִשְׁקָל לִכְפוֹר וּכְפוֹר וְלִכְפוֹרֵי הַכֶּסֶף בְּמִשְׁקָל לִכְפוֹר וּכְפוֹר׃

verses.english: and for the incense altar, refined gold by weight, and gold for the pattern of the chariot, the cherubim spreading out and covering the ark of YHWH's covenant.
verses.hebrew: וּלְמִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת זָהָב מְזֻקָּק בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּלְתַבְנִית הַמֶּרְכָּבָה הַכְּרֻבִים זָהָב לְפֹרְשִׂים וְסֹכְכִים עַל־אֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: “All this, in writing from YHWH's hand upon me, He made me understand—all the works of the plan.”
verses.hebrew: הַכֹּל בִּכְתָב מִיַּד יְהוָה עָלַי הִשְׂכִּיל כֹּל מַלְאֲכוֹת הַתַּבְנִית׃

verses.english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous and act. Do not fear or be dismayed, for YHWH God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work of the service of YHWH's house is finished.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ חֲזַק וֶאֱמַץ וַעֲשֵׂה אַל־תִּירָא וְאַל־תֵּחָת כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהַי עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ עַד־לִכְלוֹת כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Look, the divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the service of God's house. With you in every kind of work is every willing person skilled in every service, and the officials and all the people are ready for all your words.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה מַחְלְקוֹת הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְכָל־עֲבוֹדַת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וְעִמְּךָ בְכָל־מְלָאכָה לְכָל־נָדִיב בַּחָכְמָה לְכָל־עֲבוֹדָה וְהַשָּׂרִים וְכָל־הָעָם לְכָל־דְּבָרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: King David said to the whole assembly, “Solomon my son, the one God has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great, for the palace is for YHWH God, not for a human being.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד הַמֶּלֶךְ לְכָל־הַקָּהָל שְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי אֶחָד בָּחַר־בּוֹ אֱלֹהִים נַעַר וָרָךְ וְהַמְּלָאכָה גְדוֹלָה כִּי לֹא לְאָדָם הַבִּירָה כִּי לַיהוָה אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: With all my strength I have prepared for my God's house: gold for the gold work, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, timber for the timber, shoham stones and setting stones, stones of antimony and variegated work, every precious stone, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.hebrew: וּכְכָל־כֹּחִי הֲכִינוֹתִי לְבֵית־אֱלֹהַי הַזָּהָב לַזָּהָב וְהַכֶּסֶף לַכֶּסֶף וְהַנְּחֹשֶׁת לַנְּחֹשֶׁת הַבַּרְזֶל לַבַּרְזֶל וְהָעֵצִים לָעֵצִים אַבְנֵי־שֹׁהַם וּמִלּוּאִים אַבְנֵי־פוּךְ וְרִקְמָה וְכֹל אֶבֶן יְקָרָה וְאַבְנֵי־שַׁיִשׁ לָרֹב׃

verses.english: Moreover, because I delight in my God's house, I have a personal treasure of gold and silver that I give to my God's house, beyond all I have prepared for the holy house:
verses.hebrew: וְעוֹד בִּרְצוֹתִי בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי יֶשׁ־לִי סְגֻלָּה זָהָב וָכָסֶף נָתַתִּי לְבֵית־אֱלֹהַי לְמַעְלָה מִכָּל־הֲכִינוֹתִי לְבֵית הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: three thousand talents of gold from Ophir's gold, and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay the walls of the houses;
verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים כִּכְּרֵי זָהָב מִזְּהַב אוֹפִיר וְשִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף מְזֻקָּק לָטוּחַ קִירוֹת הַבָּתִּים׃

verses.english: gold for the gold work and silver for the silver work, and for every work by the craftsmen's hand. Who is willing to fill his hand today for YHWH?”
verses.hebrew: לַזָּהָב לַזָּהָב וְלַכֶּסֶף לַכֶּסֶף וּלְכָל־מְלָאכָה בְּיַד חָרָשִׁים וּמִי מִתְנַדֵּב לְמַלֹּאות יָדוֹ הַיּוֹם לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: The ancestral officials, the officials of Israel's tribes, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the officials of the king's work gave willingly.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְנַדְּבוּ שָׂרֵי הָאָבוֹת וְשָׂרֵי שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וּלְשָׂרֵי מְלֶאכֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: They gave for the service of God's house five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand darics, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדַת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים זָהָב כִּכָּרִים חֲמֵשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים וַאֲדַרְכֹנִים רִבּוֹ וְכֶסֶף כִּכָּרִים עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וּנְחֹשֶׁת רִבּוֹ וּשְׁמוֹנַת אֲלָפִים כִּכָּרִים וּבַרְזֶל מֵאָה־אֶלֶף כִּכָּרִים׃

verses.english: Those who had stones gave them to the treasury of YHWH's house through Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּמְצָא אִתּוֹ אֲבָנִים נָתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר בֵּית־יְהוָה עַל יַד־יְחִיאֵל הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי׃

verses.english: The people rejoiced over their willing gifts, because they gave willingly to YHWH with a whole heart. King David also rejoiced greatly.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ הָעָם עַל־הִתְנַדְּבָם כִּי בְּלֵב שָׁלֵם הִתְנַדְּבוּ לַיהוָה וְגַם דָּוִיד הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׂמַח שִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה׃

verses.english: David blessed YHWH before the eyes of the whole assembly. David said, “Blessed are You, YHWH, God of Israel our father, from everlasting to everlasting.
verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרֶךְ דָּוִיד אֶת־יְהוָה לְעֵינֵי כָּל־הַקָּהָל וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִינוּ מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Yours, YHWH, are greatness, might, splendor, victory, and majesty, for all in heaven and earth is Yours. Yours, YHWH, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ יְהוָה הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת וְהַנֵּצַח וְהַהוֹד כִּי־כֹל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ לְךָ יְהוָה הַמַּמְלָכָה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: Wealth and honor come from before You. You rule over all. In Your hand are power and might, and in Your hand it is to make all great and strong.
verses.hebrew: וְהָעֹשֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְאַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בַּכֹּל וּבְיָדְךָ כֹּחַ וּגְבוּרָה וּבְיָדְךָ לְגַדֵּל וּלְחַזֵּק לַכֹּל׃

verses.english: Now, our God, we thank You and praise Your splendid name.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ וּמְהַלְלִים לְשֵׁם תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Who am I, and who are my people, that we should have strength to give willingly like this? Everything is from You, and from Your hand we have given to You.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי מִי אֲנִי וּמִי עַמִּי כִּי־נַעְצֹר כֹּחַ לְהִתְנַדֵּב כָּזֹאת כִּי־מִמְּךָ הַכֹּל וּמִיָּדְךָ נָתַנּוּ לָךְ׃

verses.english: For we are strangers and sojourners before You, like all our fathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, and there is no hope.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־גֵרִים אֲנַחְנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִים כְּכָל־אֲבֹתֵינוּ כַּצֵּל יָמֵינוּ עַל־הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין מִקְוֶה׃

verses.english: YHWH our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your holy name is from Your hand, and everything is Yours.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כֹל הֶהָמוֹן הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֲכִינֹנוּ לִבְנוֹת־לְךָ בַיִת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ מִיָּדְךָ היא [הוּא] וּלְךָ הַכֹּל׃

verses.english: I know, my God, that You test the heart and delight in uprightness. In the uprightness of my heart I have given all these things willingly. Now I have seen Your people present here give willingly to You with joy.
verses.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתִּי אֱלֹהַי כִּי אַתָּה בֹּחֵן לֵבָב וּמֵישָׁרִים תִּרְצֶה אֲנִי בְּיֹשֶׁר לְבָבִי הִתְנַדַּבְתִּי כָל־אֵלֶּה וְעַתָּה עַמְּךָ הַנִּמְצְאוּ־פֹה רָאִיתִי בְשִׂמְחָה לְהִתְנַדֶּב־לָךְ׃

verses.english: YHWH, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel our fathers, preserve this forever in the formation of the thoughts of Your people's heart, and establish their heart toward You.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבֹתֵינוּ שֳׁמְרָה־זֹּאת לְעוֹלָם לְיֵצֶר מַחְשְׁבוֹת לְבַב עַמֶּךָ וְהָכֵן לְבָבָם אֵלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Give Solomon my son a whole heart to keep Your commandments, testimonies, and statutes, to do everything, and to build the palace for which I have prepared.”
verses.hebrew: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹה בְנִי תֵּן לֵבָב שָׁלֵם לִשְׁמוֹר מִצְוֺתֶיךָ עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ וְחֻקֶּיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת הַכֹּל וְלִבְנוֹת הַבִּירָה אֲשֶׁר־הֲכִינוֹתִי׃

verses.english: David said to the whole assembly, “Please bless YHWH your God.” The whole assembly blessed YHWH, the God of their fathers. They bowed down and prostrated themselves before YHWH and the king.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר דָּוִיד לְכָל־הַקָּהָל בָּרְכוּ־נָא אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וַיְבָרֲכוּ כָל־הַקָּהָל לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְּדוּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה וְלַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: On the next day they sacrificed sacrifices to YHWH and offered burnt offerings to YHWH: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ לַיהוָה זְבָחִים וַיַּעֲלוּ עֹלוֹת לַיהוָה לְמָחֳרַת הַיּוֹם הַהוּא פָּרִים אֶלֶף אֵילִים אֶלֶף כְּבָשִׂים אֶלֶף וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם וּזְבָחִים לָרֹב לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: They ate and drank before YHWH that day with great joy. They made Solomon son of David king a second time and anointed him for YHWH as leader, and Zadok as priest.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא בְּשִׂמְחָה גְדוֹלָה וַיַּמְלִיכוּ שֵׁנִית לִשְׁלֹמֹה בֶן־דָּוִיד וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ לַיהוָה לְנָגִיד וּלְצָדוֹק לְכֹהֵן׃

verses.english: Solomon sat upon YHWH's throne as king in place of David his father and prospered. All Israel obeyed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב שְׁלֹמֹה עַל־כִּסֵּא יְהוָה לְמֶלֶךְ תַּחַת־דָּוִיד אָבִיו וַיַּצְלַח וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: All the officials and mighty men, and all King David's sons as well, gave their hand in submission under King Solomon.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַשָּׂרִים וְהַגִּבֹּרִים וְגַם כָּל־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִיד נָתְנוּ יָד תַּחַת שְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: YHWH made Solomon exceedingly great before the eyes of all Israel and bestowed royal majesty upon him such as no king before him over Israel had possessed.
verses.hebrew: וַיְגַדֵּל יְהוָה אֶת־שְׁלֹמֹה לְמַעְלָה לְעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו הוֹד מַלְכוּת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיָה עַל־כָּל־מֶלֶךְ לְפָנָיו עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: David son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְדָוִיד בֶּן־יִשָׁי מָלַךְ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The time he reigned over Israel was forty years. In Hebron he reigned seven years, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three.
verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּחֶבְרוֹן מָלַךְ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם מָלַךְ שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: He died in a good old age, full of days, wealth, and honor. Solomon his son reigned in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה שְׂבַע יָמִים עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד וַיִּמְלֹךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃

verses.english: The deeds of King David, first and last, are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet, and the records of Gad the seer,
verses.hebrew: וְדִבְרֵי דָּוִיד הַמֶּלֶךְ הָרִאשֹׁנִים וְהָאֲחרֹנִים הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־דִּבְרֵי שְׁמוּאֵל הָרֹאֶה וְעַל־דִּבְרֵי נָתָן הַנָּבִיא וְעַל־דִּבְרֵי גָּד הַחֹזֶה׃

verses.english: with all his kingdom and might, and the times that passed over him, over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the lands.
verses.hebrew: עִם כָּל־מַלְכוּתוֹ וּגְבוּרָתוֹ וְהָעִתִּים אֲשֶׁר עָבְרוּ עָלָיו וְעַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל כָּל־מַמְלְכוֹת הָאֲרָצוֹת׃
